ggicons

The ggicons package allows you to visualise data with icons in ggplot2. It uses icons from the icons package as the icon aesthetic in geom_icon().

Installation

You can install the development version from GitHub

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mitchelloharawild/ggicons")
